content.name: Chloe Ashworth
content.title: Operations Manager
content.summary: Operations manager with nine years in food manufacturing, parcel logistics and e-commerce fulfilment. Runs a 220,000 sq ft furniture distribution centre with 160 staff across two shifts and cut cost per order by 14% while peak volumes doubled.

experience.title: Operations Manager
bullets: Manage a 220,000 sq ft fulfilment centre with 160 permanent and agency staff across two shifts.
Re-slotted 4,000 SKUs by velocity and introduced zone picking, reducing cost per order by 14% as Black Friday volumes doubled.
Cut damaged-in-transit claims by 31% by redesigning packing standards with the carrier and the product team.
Lead four shift managers and coach them on absence management and performance conversations.
Hold a site budget of £6.8m and report weekly to the head of supply chain.

experience.title: Operations Team Leader
bullets: Led a night sort team of 45 processing up to 60,000 parcels a shift.
Improved sorter induction rates by 9% through better trailer scheduling with the transport office.
Ran return-to-work interviews and reduced short-term absence from 7.5% to 4.8%.

experience.title: Production Shift Manager
bullets: Managed three bread lines and 30 operatives on a rotating shift pattern.
Prepared the site for a BRCGS Food Safety audit that achieved an AA grade.
Lowered line waste from 6% to 3.9% with a changeover checklist and daily root-cause reviews.

courses.name: Level 5 Certificate in Management and Leadership
